translations.web: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,
translations.bsb: Do not hasten to leave his presence, and do not persist in a bad cause, for he will do whatever he pleases.
translations.kjv: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth
